note: NECO Marketing round 5 (R28 top-up): production, selling, marketing and societal concepts; the 4Ps mix; convenience, specialty and industrial goods; service intangibility; brand equity, brand vs line extension; idea generation first, test marketing's purpose; prestige pricing, loss leader, price lining; wholesaler bulk-breaking, broker takes no title, intensive distribution, physical distribution bundle; coupons and samples, audience-first media choice, publicity, quota, territory, canvassing; right to information, consumerism, caveat emptor; perishability and inseparability of services; relationship marketing; social media, email marketing, SEO; marketing audit and executive summary. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Marketing (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
